# pi-web-search

> Pi tools for best-effort public web and public code retrieval with source links when available. Research and external Jev judgment are separate opt-ins, off by default.

This file is a navigation index for agents, not an API specification or a retrieval/performance feature. Paths are relative to this package. For the monorepo, see [root llms.txt](../llms.txt).

## Documentation

- [Package README](README.md): requirements, release status, isolated-subfolder installation, first search, and tool payloads.
- [Configuration](README.md#configuration): retrieval defaults, normalization, config location, and reload behavior.
- [Credentials](README.md#credentials): environment precedence, literal auth.json format, and settings-report limits.
- [Code qualifiers](README.md#code-qualifiers): repo:/language: translation, provider differences, and inconclusive zero hits.
- [Provider behavior and limits](README.md#provider-behavior-and-limits): eligibility, excerpt/citation limits, and fallback scope.
- [Timeouts, fallback, and errors](README.md#timeouts-fallback-and-errors): deadline and partial-result semantics; troubleshooting.
- [Data handling](README.md#data-handling): external query/evidence egress, untrusted content, and privacy boundaries.
- [Research and Jev reference](docs/research.md): every judgment setting/default, backend selection, external data flow, and fail-open outcomes.

## Source contracts

- [Tool registration](src/index.ts): tool exposure, guidance, namespace, and settings command.
- [Configuration resolver](src/providers/config.ts): accepted settings and effective defaults.
- [Provider orchestration](src/providers/index.ts): ordinary chains versus research fan-out.
- [Structured output schema and formatter](src/format.ts): fields, previews, truncation, and error results.
